title: Generic qPCR Setup Protocol (Station C)
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol bundle
steps.instruction: Download the protocol bundle files from the Opentrons resource page.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition
steps.instruction: If a custom labware definition is required, upload it to the OT‑2 App before loading the protocol.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT‑App
steps.instruction: Import the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (version 3.19.0 or later).

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck exactly as shown in the protocol deck map.

substeps.instruction: Place the Opentrons Temperature Module with the Aluminum Block Set on the designated slot.
Insert the 24‑well aluminum block onto the Temperature Module and load the 1.5 mL tube containing the reaction mix (master mix + primers/probes).
Place the qPCR plate on its designated slot.
Place the source plate that holds the purified nucleic‑acid samples (from Station B) on its designated slot.
Load tip racks for the Single‑Channel Pipette (and optional 8‑channel pipette) on their designated slots.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and the selected pipette (Single‑Channel or optional 8‑channel).

steps.title: Transfer reaction mix
steps.instruction: Using the Single‑Channel Pipette (or optional 8‑channel pipette), aspirate the reaction mix from the 1.5 mL tube in the 24‑well aluminum block and dispense it into the specified wells of the qPCR plate.

steps.title: Add samples and mix
steps.instruction: Using the same pipette, aspirate each purified nucleic‑acid sample from its source plate and dispense it into the corresponding well of the qPCR plate, then mix with the reaction mix.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: In the OT‑2 Run App, press “Run” to execute the automated qPCR setup protocol.
